task.description:
Design and implement tests for Batch F2c on branch feature/WF02-f2c-batch2-20260529:

1. **PD-09 (backend integration tests)**: Test export endpoint returns 200 with bpm_export_schema_version. Test import creates DRAFT with new UUID. Test import validation rejects invalid schemas. Test import 409 for duplicate name+version.

2. **PD-10 (backend integration tests)**: Test search returns ranked results. Test empty query returns 422. Test no matches returns empty array. Test case-insensitive matching.

3. **PD-UI-07 (frontend E2E tests)**: Test Export button downloads JSON. Test Import button accepts file.

4. **PD-UI-08 (frontend E2E tests)**: Test search bar with debounce. Test results display.

Write test spec files to tests/specs/ and test source files to appropriate layer.
acceptance_criteria: Every MUST/SHOULD requirement has a runnable test
Backend integration tests connect to real PostgreSQL
Frontend E2E tests are against real backend (no mocks)

result.summary: Test specs and test code for PD-09, PD-10, PD-UI-07, PD-UI-08
